440156.overview: The game is a platformer where you have to walk through and save all the power rings that powers the park itself. While going through these stages, you will have to solve a problem relating to learning the Alphabet.

443111.overview:
Join Little Red Riding Hood on her adventures, and solve vocabulary, logic and color puzzles as you help her journey to Grandma's house.
Watch out, watch out! There's a wolf about!
